title: Export all matching daily loading-list evidence summaries to Excel
description: Add separate summary Excel download in the existing designer and POST export-summary on DynamicContainerStatsReportController. Revalidate current request and fresh permissions; reuse BuildPageAsync full-match Summary or shared validated source, independent of current page, selected detail columns and posted/cached totals. Direct narrow DynamicContainerStatsSummaryExcelExporter with existing NPOI, no registration changes. Fixed daily sheet: date, evidence-bucket/list/missing-number-list counts and signed recorded cartons/kg/m3 each separately; separate period totals/context sheet. Do not append customer/container/list detail rows or global unique-customer totals. Dates/numeric counts/signed measures use appropriate cells, zero and negative retained without currency formatting; dangerous formula-like filter/context strings are literal text. Mandatory normalized dates/filters/full coverage/scope/source cap/units/grouping and unknown capacity/type/shipping disclaimers independent of hidden detail fields. Empty evidence workbook explicitly labelled, overflow/revoked authorization/invalid input/export failure produces no file. Separate summary-download label preserves fields/filters/current detail page and reports errors; current-page detail Excel unchanged. Development only, readonly increments in existing container-stats report architecture. Reuse current identity/container-stats menu and freshly resolved SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope on every preview/download; validated customer/raw-number/date filters intersect permission, never expand it. Only approved nondeleted ContainerLoadingList persisted header evidence, dates <=366 inclusive calendar days with whole end day via next-day exclusive overflow-safe boundary, stable Take(501) probe after all source predicates, reject >500 matching authorized headers. No client identity/scope/rows/totals or cached preview as authority. Recorded cartons/kg/m3 are signed list-header measures, not actual shipment, stock-out, physical container totals, revenue or known capacity/type; never infer utilization from 68m3 or scoped customer count. Never add unlike units or bucket customer counts into global unique-customer claims. Existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit, no business writes/audit entities. No new domain entities or persistence/schema/mapping changes required: current ContainerLoadingList already has all read fields. No migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, arbitrary/model SQL, real database execution, production deployment, irreversible data operations, credentials/secrets/.env/config/package/DI changes, XAUUSD/NEWAPP or unrelated refactors. Preserve uncommitted work. Focused in-memory service/controller/export and UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release restore/build/test; unavailable real database/browser validation is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Dedicated summary Excel endpoint revalidates fresh identity/menu/customer scope and current input, rebuilding full-match summaries independent of selected fields/detail page and rejecting revocation, invalid input or overflow.

Workbook contains fixed daily summary and separate period context, numeric signed unit measures/counts and literal formula-safe context, with mandatory full coverage and no appended business detail or unsupported totals.

Existing page offers separately labelled summary Excel download and retains detail state on success/failure; workbook/controller/UI tests cover multiple pages, empty evidence, signed values, missing numbers and permission/source limits, and safe build/test passes.
